creator_agreement.interpretive_context: PER B2Z-P2G's already-qualified finding (GENUINE_SHARED_MIGRATION_SIGNER_NOT_TOKEN_CREATOR, confirmed not a bug): this low rate is substantially explained by resolve_creator()'s contract measuring the migration-transaction's SOLE SIGNER, which for 9 of these 19 members (47.4%) turned out to be a single shared address (9C4nRvhhVquC...) acting as an apparent migration-completion agent for tokens it did not create -- NOT evidence that the local CREATE-tx-derived predictions were generally wrong. This rate should NOT be read as 'local predictions are 63% inaccurate' without that context.

funding_signature_agreement.interpretive_context: this figure is measured ONLY over the 9 members where a funding signature comparison was possible (the 9 Stage-2-seeded MEMBER_COMPLETE members) -- IDENTICAL to the Stage-2 skip confirmation rate below, since for seeded members Stage 3 is dispatched directly against the frozen local signature by construction. This is NOT independent confirmation from a separately-discovered raw signature; see stage2_skip_calibration for the correct interpretation.

direct_funder_agreement.reason: the raw funder/source address was not independently persisted into the durable stage-output ledger by this implementation (only the destination/creator and signature were recorded) -- this is a genuine data-capture gap in the current B2Z-P1 stage-output schema, not a 0% disagreement finding. Reported honestly as NOT_MEASURED rather than folded into a misleading 0.0 rate.

destination_agreement.interpretive_context: for all 9 MEMBER_COMPLETE members, proves_inbound_sol_funding() by definition validated destination==creator (this is the pass condition) -- this metric confirms the executor enforced its own contract correctly, not an independent raw discovery

amount_agreement.reason: same data-capture gap as direct_funder_agreement -- raw lamports amount was not persisted into the stage-output ledger

temporal_agreement.interpretive_context: funding_time < migration_time is enforced by resume_next() as a hard validation gate (B2Z_P1_FUNDING_TIME_INVALID) before any MEMBER_COMPLETE can occur -- so this 100% is a structural guarantee of the executor for all COMPLETE members, not an independent measurement

complete_relationship_agreement.interpretive_context: THIS FIGURE IS MISLEADING IF READ LITERALLY. It is 0% because the underlying comparison engine (src/acquisition/b2z_calibration_comparison.py, built in a prior milestone, used AS-IS and unmodified this turn) requires ALL fields including creator to match for 'complete agreement', and creator legitimately disagrees for the seeded MEMBER_COMPLETE members per the P2G finding (the seed mechanism intentionally tests the LOCAL creator against the frozen signature, independent of what the raw migration-tx signer resolved to). The more meaningful figure is: 8 of 19 members (42.1%) reached MEMBER_COMPLETE (genuine raw-proven funding evidence exists), and of those, 9 signature/destination/temporal fields were 100% self-consistent by construction. Recommend NOT using complete_relationship_agreement as a headline metric without this caveat.

stage2_skip_calibration.purpose: measures whether local transfer_index signatures can safely eliminate creator-history RPC in future selective verification -- the primary reason this calibration sprint was authorized
stage2_skip_calibration.significance: STRONG POSITIVE RESULT for the core hypothesis: every single frozen local funding signature that was seeded (skipping a live CREATOR_HISTORY RPC call) was subsequently confirmed by a real, dispatched Stage-3 getTransaction call against exactly that signature. Zero contradictions. This directly supports the case that local transfer_index-derived signatures CAN safely replace CREATOR_HISTORY RPC for at least this sample's seeded population.
stage2_skip_calibration.caveat_small_sample: n=9 is a modest sample; a 100% rate with this denominator has a wide confidence interval (a single future contradiction would drop the rate to ~89%). Should be treated as a strong initial positive signal, not proof at scale.
stage2_skip_calibration.caveat_seeded_population_was_preselected: the 9 seeded members were chosen BECAUSE their local_completeness_confidence was HIGH (per the original prediction-freeze reconstruction method) -- this 100% rate reflects confirmation performance specifically for HIGH-confidence local predictions, and should not be extrapolated to LOW-confidence predictions (which the live/unseeded group, including both raw-negative cases, exclusively represents)

live_stage2_population_result.purpose: the complementary population -- 10 members where CREATOR_HISTORY was a real, live, dispatched RPC call rather than seeded
live_stage2_population_result.striking_finding: ZERO of the 10 live (unseeded) members reached a positive MEMBER_COMPLETE outcome -- 8 found no candidate at all, and the 2 that DID find a candidate (8, 19) both failed semantic validation. This is a stark contrast with the 9/9 (100%) seeded confirmation rate, though the two populations are NOT directly comparable (seeded members were preselected for HIGH local confidence; live members were, by the prediction-freeze construction method, predominantly LOW confidence and/or flagged for fan-out review -- see stage2_skip_calibration caveat above). This finding should prompt caution before assuming LOW-confidence local predictions are reliable, while the seeded/HIGH-confidence result remains strongly positive.
live_stage2_population_result.creator_role_mismatch_within_live_popula: 7 of the 10 live members (3,5,9,11,15,16,18) show a raw creator that disagrees with the local creator -- for 6 of those 7, the raw creator is the shared migration-signer address documented in B2Z-P2G, not a distinct wrong-answer pattern each time
